In Hindu culture, names often reflect aspects of the deities or stories within the religion. "Mistar" may have been given to individuals who ruled over misty lands or villages, symbolizing their ability to navigate through uncertain situations.

The name evokes a sense of control and understanding over the unpredictable nature of life, as one who can lead through the fog and reveal clarity.
